summary: Iteration 63 — Amazon India Bulk Pickup Sheet feature validated end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passing (preview + export endpoints, filters, role guards, 44-column workbook, autofill values, COD/prepaid CollectOnDelivery flag, DD-MM-YYYY invoice date, phone/state normalization, empty-result 404). Frontend: IM login lands on /inventory; '📦 Amazon Sheet' tab loads AmazonPickupExportPanel; filter changes update match count (all=60, cod=0/prepaid=0 on default today's date, all-dates+all=60); .xlsx download triggered with correct filename; weight/dimension inputs editable and applied. Meta CAPI regression smoke passed.

issues: Order date defaults to today (2026-07-24) so initial count = 0; clearing the date box works but is not obvious. Consider defaulting to blank/'all dates' or adding an explicit 'All dates' toggle.

critical_code_review_comments: amazon_pickup_module.py payment_type='prepaid' filter uses {$nin: ['cod','COD']} — this correctly classifies free-influencer/UPI/razorpay orders as prepaid; verified via UI (FREE_INFLUENCER row appears with CollectOnDelivery=N when 'prepaid' selected). Fine.
order_date filter uses UTC day boundary; if users are in IST, midnight IST orders can fall into adjacent UTC day. Non-blocking but worth documenting.
AmazonPickupExportPanel.jsx: weight/dim inputs use raw e.target.value (string) — accepted by backend Query(float=…), but consider Number(e.target.value) for cleanliness.
Ship-From/Return-To are blank when company_settings has no warehouse — intentional per spec, but IM has no UI to edit them; a small hint would help.
